# The Old Harbour

The old harbour is where the fishing boats come home. This guide covers the
walk along the quay, the boats you will see and where to eat.

## Walking the quay

Start at the lighthouse and follow the quay to the fish market. See the
[town map](https://example.org/map) and the [timetable](./timetable.md).

![The lighthouse at dusk](lighthouse.jpg)

### Things to bring

- [x] Comfortable shoes
- [ ] A camera
- [ ] Coins for the ferry
